تحتارون (form VIII)
# تَحْتَارُونَ (taḥtārūna) /taħ.taː.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَارَ (iḥtāra)
# تُحْتَارُونَ (tuḥtārūna) /tuħ.taː.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَارَ (iḥtāra)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
